description: Sub-agent routing + deviance check toggles. 'mode' (auto|manual) controls the director hook; 'deviance_mode' (on|off) controls D50 deviance detection and tool-event telemetry. Read by scripts/subagent-routing-hook.mjs, scripts/subagent-telemetry.mjs, and scripts/subagent-deviance-check.mjs.
flipWith: node scripts/subagent-routing.mjs on|off  |  node scripts/subagent-deviance.mjs on|off
statusWith: node scripts/subagent-routing.mjs status  |  node scripts/subagent-deviance.mjs status
